Sohu/Autohome list it as 2026款 of the same series.
rationale: Indirect competitor one price tier below the 5 Series Li/i5. Sohu (https://db.auto.sohu.com/trim_181651/dianping) lists the 2026 SU7 at 21.99-30.39万 vs BMW 5 Series 36.8-52.59万 on the same page. Autohome's SU7 page (cited url) lists BMW 5 Series among its popular comparisons (热门对比), and SU7 owners on Sohu benchmark it against BMW 3 Series/Audi A4; CarNewsChina benchmarks it against Tesla Model 3. Best-selling premium EV sedan in China; sets buyer expectations for HMI, phone ecosystem, ADAS and value that the 5 Series Li is judged against.

Direct price overlap: Sohu lists the 2024 ET7 at 42.8-45.8万, inside the 5 Series Li/i5 range. Executive-sedan format with a 3,060 mm wheelbase, air suspension and rear-comfort focus. A Sohu owner explicitly cross-shopped BMW, Mercedes, Audi and Lexus before buying. No 2025/2026 update found in fetched sources; still listed on Sohu.

generation: S7 1st gen (2023-); facelifts 2025-08 (ADS 4, air suspension) and 2026-03 (896-channel lidar)
rationale: Indirect competitor at 22.98-28.98万 (Autohome, 2025 update; the rival it names is the Xiaomi SU7). Included because Sohu S7 owners explicitly compare it with a family BMW 5 Series (more space, more enjoyable to drive) and an Audi A6L, so it draws buyers from BBA households. It is Huawei's ADS/HarmonyOS showcase sedan. Sales were called 'underwhelming' by CarNewsChina in 2024-03.

Fifth model, chosen instead of Xpeng P7+/BYD Han L: it is the only candidate with a fetched source naming the BMW 5 Series as a rival. CnEVPost (2025-11) says it competes with the Mercedes E-Class, BMW 5 Series and Audi A6L. The 2025 refresh is priced from 30.98万 (EREV) and 32.98-36.98万 (BEV), with a 3,050 mm wheelbase. A Sohu owner test-drove a BMW i5 and chose the S9 for its standard equipment. Li Auto and AITO have no sedan; this is HIMA's executive sedan.
